title: Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors: descriptive metadata for custom connectors and their schema properties
summary: The Graph calls, permissions, licensing and roadmap facts are supported, but the statement that untouched connections stay uncategorized is too broad: people-data connectors must use people. Limit that statement to connections without an explicitly supplied category; the schema guide's older availability wording also merits a note.

claims.claim: The planned change concerns descriptive metadata for custom Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors.
claims.quote: We’re introducing new options that allow admins and developers to enrich their custom Copilot connectors and its schema properties with descriptive metadata.

claims.claim: The planned metadata supplies Copilot's model with context to improve search and chat responses.
claims.quote: Provide richer context about the connection and its schema properties to Copilot’s LLM, enabling more accurate and relevant responses.

claims.claim: The v1.0 schema property resource has a human-readable description.

claims.claim: Schema property descriptions are optional.
claims.quote: Optional but we recommend that you use this property for queryable properties.

claims.claim: Schema property descriptions help Copilot interpret queries and map them to properties.
claims.quote: This property enhances semantic understanding by helping Copilot interpret queries and accurately map them to properties that results in more relevant and precise responses.

claims.claim: A schema property description supports at most 200 characters.
claims.quote: The maximum supported length is 200 characters.

claims.claim: People-data connector descriptions on properties with person* labels are ignored.

Added the contentCategory property to the externalConnection to specify the domain category of the content associated with the external connection for improved relevance and ranking.

claims.claim: The documented metadata is an optional developer-selected capability, with no separate admin activation required.
claims.quote: Optional but we recommend that you use this property for queryable properties. Searched: Copilot connectors metadata enrichment contentCategory description tenant admin switch enable default. Read resource, update, management and discovery pages; no activation switch found.

claims.claim: Connections that nobody updates stay uncategorized.
claims.quote: Copilot connectors that contain people data must have the value people in the contentCategory property of the externalConnections API.
claims.fix: Replace 'The documented properties are optional, so connections that nobody updates stay uncategorized and keep the descriptions they have' with 'The documented properties are optional. The default category is uncategorized when no category is supplied; descriptions need not be changed.' This avoids implying that an existing explicitly categorized connection is uncategorized.

claims.claim: Existing connection descriptions need not change when they are not updated.
claims.quote: Existing properties that aren't included in the request body maintain their previous values or are recalculated based on changes to other property values.

claims.claim: Connectors containing people data must set contentCategory to people.
claims.quote: Copilot connectors that contain people data must have the value people in the contentCategory property of the externalConnections API.
